units.source_text: 二十日的月亮迟迟地升起，夜色清幽可爱。

en.t: The moon on the twentieth night rose slowly, and the night was clear, quiet, and lovely.

units.source_text: 朱雀帝说：“此刻正是饮酒作乐之时！”

en.t: Emperor Suzaku said, "This is just the time to drink wine and make merry!"

units.source_text: 但源氏大将起身告辞，奏道：“藤壶母后今晚出宫，臣拟前往东宫探望太子。

en.t: But the Genji general rose to take his leave and said, "Her Majesty Fujitsubo will leave the palace tonight, so I intend to go to the Eastern Palace to visit the Crown Prince.

units.source_text: 父皇遗命，嘱臣看顾太子，太子又别无保护人，臣理应尽力照拂。

en.t: The late emperor entrusted me with caring for the Crown Prince, and since the prince has no other protector, I ought to do all I can to look after him.

units.source_text: 由于太子情分，对母后亦当体恤。”

en.t: Out of affection for the Crown Prince, I should also show consideration for his mother."

units.source_text: 朱雀帝答道：“父皇遗嘱，命朕视太子如己子，故朕亦甚为关心。

en.t: Emperor Suzaku replied, "Our father's final command was that I regard the Crown Prince as my own child, so I too am deeply concerned for him.

units.source_text: 惟特地张扬其事，亦有所不便，故常保留在心中。

en.t: But it would be awkward to make a point of proclaiming this openly, so I always keep it in my heart.

units.source_text: 太子年龄虽幼，而笔迹异常优秀。

en.t: Although the Crown Prince is still young, his handwriting is extraordinarily fine.

units.source_text: 朕躬万事愚庸，有此聪颖之太子，顿觉面目增光也。”

en.t: I myself am foolish and mediocre in all things, but having such a brilliant Crown Prince suddenly brings honor to my name."

units.source_text: 源氏大将又奏：“就大体而言，太子确甚聪颖，竟有成人模样。

en.t: The Genji general then said, "Broadly speaking, the Crown Prince is indeed very intelligent, and even has the bearing of an adult.

units.source_text: 然而年仅六龄，终未成器。”

en.t: Yet he is only six years old, and in the end he is still not fully formed."

units.source_text: 便将太子日常情况详细奏闻，然后退朝。

en.t: He then reported the Crown Prince's daily circumstances in detail, and afterward withdrew from court.
